description: A tutorial notebook demonstrating per-sample gradient computation in PyTorch, including naive implementation, use of functorch for efficient computation, and performance benchmarking.

classes.name: SimpleCNN
classes.description: A simple convolutional neural network model for image classification.

methods.name: loss_fn
methods.description: Computes the negative log likelihood loss between predictions and targets.

methods.name: compute_grad
methods.description: Computes per-sample gradients by performing forward and backward passes for individual samples.

methods.name: compute_sample_grads
methods.description: Manually computes per-sample gradients for a batch by iterating over each sample.

methods.name: ft_compute_grad
methods.description: Function generated by functorch.grad to compute gradient for a single sample.

methods.name: ft_compute_sample_grad
methods.description: Vectorized version of ft_compute_grad to compute per-sample gradients over a batch.

methods.name: get_perf
methods.description: Compares performance timings between different methods of computing per-sample gradients.
